description: This file defines the 'BasketViewModel' class, which models the data for a shopping basket page in the web application. It contains properties for basket ID, items, buyer ID, and a method to calculate the total price.

classes.name: BasketViewModel
classes.description: A view model representing the shopping basket with properties for ID, items, buyer ID, and a method to compute total cost.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total cost of all items in the basket, rounded to two decimal places.
